title: Colonel Hohman sold SDI to Reagan using false alien threat
summary: Steven Greer tells of Colonel Hohman sold SDI to Reagan using false alien threat, about 1980s at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Now, he told me, he said, "We knew that was false, but it got billions of dollars for SDI."

plain: A doctor and UFO disclosure campaigner named Steven Greer says a military officer, Colonel Hohman, told him about how the Strategic Defense Initiative, or SDI, the 1980s US plan for a missile shield in space, was sold to President Ronald Reagan. Greer says Hohman told him they pitched it using a threat from aliens that they knew was false, and it brought in billions of dollars for SDI. If true, it would mean fear of aliens was used on purpose to fund weapons.
